basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Founding Engineer | Full-Stack + AI | PropTech Builder | 3x Founder
basics.summary: Founding engineer by instinct. Built Dronistics from zero (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL/AWS) that shipped 500+ real-world drone deliveries, and currently building Proplab, an AI-native PropTech MVP for property inspections. 13+ years shipping production systems to 10M+ users: architecture, APIs, databases, AI pipelines, on-call. At LumApps I ship production AI agents on Python and FastAPI with OpenAI, MCP tools, and Stripe-style third-party integrations. Zurich-based, remote-native, product-obsessed, and fastest at zero-to-one.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Built and shipped production AI agent workflows on Python, FastAPI, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, with tools exposed over MCP and state streamed to the UI over AG-UI. Automates outbound sales end to end: 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day, $1M forecast in quarterly revenue.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware memory every agent reads and writes. Event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub, integrations across the ecosystem.
Own the platform end to end: agent architecture, eval pipelines, tracing (LangSmith), cost-per-request instrumentation, and on-call for global production. Report directly to C-level on outcomes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end to end (Java, Vue, PostgreSQL, Elastic Search on Kubernetes). Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ revenue, $500K ARR. Designed for 99.99% SLA, integrated with third-party job boards for automatic scraping.
Replaced a $337K annual vendor translation contract with an LLM pipeline (GitHub Actions + OpenAI APIs) shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated, product team iterates without external gatekeepers.
Designed distributed templating engine on Java and Kafka that cut customer setup time 90%. Powers 15% of all platform assets for 10M+ users. Zero-to-live in minutes, not days.
Ran observability and global on-call (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io): logs, metrics, dashboards, alerting. Diagnosed and fixed production issues across service, DB, and infra layers.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer for an EPFL spin-off. Shipped the full autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL) that powered 500+ real-world last-mile deliveries. Built the stack from scratch: APIs, DBs, real-time flight control, dashboards.

Built AWS infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled a Unilever partnership and a CES Las Vegas showcase. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.

projects.name: Proplab - AI for Real Estate (PropTech)
projects.description: Property inspections run on paper, clipboards, and WhatsApp photos. Built an AI-native MVP: vision pipeline extracts structured signals (room type, condition, defects) from inspection photos, replacing paper-based reports with queryable, AI-readable data. LLM agents then turn those records into multilingual, marketing-ready property listings end-to-end. One workflow from photo capture to published listing, zero copy-paste.

projects.name: Anand Creations - Forward Deployed Engineering Practice
projects.description: My independent practice and the home for AI products I design, build, and run myself (Proplab, PulseView, SwissNRI). Same playbook: pick the wedge, ship the MVP fast, wire in evals and telemetry, learn from real users, and compound.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence for retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data. Built for my own portfolio first, then opened to live users. If the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship.
